summary: Add offline dependency admission rules and exception regressions
details: Evaluate bounded license expressions with exact license-exception pairing and reject missing license metadata or high, critical and unknown-severity advisories.
Require exact dependency and advisory/license scope, owner, reason, review reference and an unexpired review window of at most 90 days for exceptions.
Run offline rule regressions in documentation validation and document dependency selection/removal criteria.

compatibility.notes: Offline tooling only; no production API, SDK or persistence contract changed.

security: Reject malformed or oversized input, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers and unsupported metadata with errors that omit raw input. No network or subprocess execution occurs in the rules library.
limitations: EVY-1407 remains incomplete: complete inventories, license-source verification, trusted live PR review, update grouping and release qualification are pending.
A review-link shape and synthetic policy tests do not prove approval or that real dependency changes are blocked by hosted CI.
